content.rendered:
There are now several options to return your registration paperwork:

  • Mail to PO Box 1342, Sherwood, OR 97140
  • Drop off at the school office lockbox (located next to the school entrance double doors) Please do not drop off OneFund donations in the lockbox.
  • Turn in during the June 4th Item Return Day: Current families may drop off registration in the lockbox during the hours scheduled for the return day. OneFund donations can also be dropped in the lockbox during this event only.

Thank you!
